描述_EN: the particular layout of the dragon motifs also marks it out from other garments in the v&a's collection. its decoration was undertaken on the loom as weaving techniques advanced, rather than being added later in the form of embroidery. it is front-fastening, whereas many other robes fasten to one side. this robe is unlike the other chinese women's garments in the museum, but we know from 18th-century pictorial sources that it was very fashionable at the time.
描述_ZN: 龙形图案的特殊布局也使它与V&A收藏的其他服装区别开来。 它的装饰是随着织造技术的发展在织机上进行的，而不是后来以刺绣的形式加入的。 它是正面扣的，而其他许多袍子都是扣在一边的。 这件袍子与博物馆中的其他中国妇女服装不同，但我们从18世纪的图片资料中得知，它在当时是非常时尚的。
